data.name: Settings_Guard_Toggle
data.value: Block commits made with the wrong identity

data.name: Settings_Guard_Description
data.value: Before each commit, checks that the author email matches the repository's profile (by remote SSH alias, otherwise by folder). Repositories outside your profiles are not checked.

data.name: Settings_Guard_Note
data.value: Uses a global core.hooksPath and keeps running each repository's own hooks (husky v4, pre-commit, Git LFS). Repositories that set their own core.hooksPath (husky v5+) are not checked. Adds about 0.3 s per commit on Windows. Skip the check once with git commit --no-verify.

data.value: GitPersona: commit blocked — the author email does not match this repository's profile.

data.name: Guard_Fix
data.value: Fix it in GitPersona (Profiles → Apply configuration), or set the email for this repository:

data.name: Guard_Bypass
data.value: Or commit once without the check:
